recommendation: Keep the audit commit for FHIR-12471. If FHIR-I decides to further clarify strictness, requirements CapabilityStatements, or client/server interpretation, handle that under FHIR-53641 or another final tracker rather than expanding this old Published issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12471 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core Conformance request to improve wording that confused CapabilityStatement.profile with CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.profile. It asked that multiple use-case profiles be described separately from the single resource-wide/common profile and objected to wording implying supported profiles typically cross resource types.
initial_application: No git commit with FHIR-12471 in its message was found. The Jira comments record the clarification as already done, while the profile-uses section existed in source. Later applied work, especially FHIR-12829 and FHIR-25462, changed the current element shape and definitions so the old top-level CapabilityStatement.profile concept is now CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile.
additional_context: FHIR-12829 moved CapabilityStatement.profile inside CapabilityStatement.rest.resource as supportedProfile. FHIR-25462 later clarified CapabilityStatement profile use cases and updated the current definitions and profiling narrative. A later Zulip discussion produced FHIR-53641, but that tracker is Triaged/Unresolved and is not final enough to drive a source change in this run.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Active build scope includes CapabilityStatement, and authoritative source now says .rest.resource.profile is a max 1 system-wide profile applied across all supported instances, while .rest.resource.supportedProfile is max * and describes use-case-specific profiles. The confusing obsolete sentence is not present in current authoritative CapabilityStatement definitions.

related_jiras.note: Moved the old top-level CapabilityStatement.profile into CapabilityStatement.rest.resource and named it supportedProfile, changing the element shape referenced by FHIR-12471.
Refined the current profile/supportedProfile definitions and profiling.html guidance used to judge the seed.
Triaged/Unresolved later concern that the distinction could still be clearer; not final enough for a source edit here.
